name: Name
description: Human-readable layer name (the resource descriptor)

name: Slug
description: Dialect-neutral layer slug (as used across the stack)

name: Icon
description: Layer icon — an inline SVG or a bundled asset reference

name: Layer Type
description: What the layer contributes (Grammar, Etymology, Glosses, …)

name: Layer Format
description: Upstream formats the layer is available in (TBX, RM, …)

name: Licensing
description: Licence and the required visible attribution

name: Licence
description: The licence under which the layer is provided

name: Attribution
description: The visible credit line to display (may hold multiple credits)

name: Description
description: Typed rich-text description

name: Description Type
description: The kind of description

name: Description Text
description: Rich-text (markdown) description body

name: Links
description: Related links (homepage, source, documentation, …)

name: Link Title
description: Human-readable link label

name: Link URL
description: The link target

name: Link Type
description: Kind of link (homepage, source, licence, documentation, …)

name: Statistics
description: Build-generated layer statistics

name: Resource Count
description: Number of resources in the layer (build-generated)

name: Statistics Block
description: Build-generated statistics as a JSON block

name: Integration
description: Structured config to load the layer into Gréasán

name: Integration Slug
description: The head slug Gréasán loads for this layer

name: Default On
description: Whether the layer is loaded by default (true/false)

name: Swatch
description: Layer swatch colour token

name: Config Block
description: Structured typed integration config as a JSON block

name: Download
description: Automatable per-format download details (a subset of the layer formats)

name: Format
description: The format this download provides

name: Download URL
description: The download URL

name: Notes
description: Notes about this download / format
